compos.text: A smartphone UI element displaying a selection of lighter designs. The main image shows a gold lighter with an engraved emblem featuring a shield and wings. Below the main image, there is a horizontal scroll bar with various lighter designs, including a blue lighter with skulls, a red lighter with a heart, and a lighter with an eye design.
Advertisement banner with the text "Plato's buys your style. Sell us your gently used clothes & accessories. No appointments needed." There is a right arrow icon next to the text.
Alt text: "Back arrow icon, indicating a navigation option to go to the previous screen or page."
"Virtual Lighter" text displayed in a glowing, fiery font.

A horizontal selection of various lighter designs displayed in a smartphone UI. The designs include a plain white lighter, a red lighter with a heart and decorative patterns, a beige lighter with an intricate emblem, a blue lighter with multiple skulls, a beige lighter with a close-up of a red eye, and a white lighter with a black and white design.

compos.summarization: This smartphone UI screen is from an app called "Virtual Lighter." The main content of the screen features a virtual lighter with a detailed design on it. Below the lighter, there is a horizontal scroll bar displaying various lighter designs that users can choose from. At the bottom of the screen, there is an advertisement banner promoting a clothing and accessories store. The navigation bar at the bottom includes standard Android navigation buttons: back, home, and recent apps.
